snippet.title: Sudden Strike 5 | France: Road to Liberation DLC | Release Trailer (US)
snippet.description:
Sudden Strike 5 – France: Road to Liberation is now available for PC, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation®5. Get 20% launch discount for the PC version in the Kalypso Store and 10% off on Steam and the Epic Games Store*! https://www.kalypsomedia.com/product-page/sudden-strike-5-france-road-to-liberation 

*Steam and Epic Games Store offer valid until 6th August.

Sudden Strike 5 returns to the front lines of World War II, where the trenches of war-torn Europe and North Africa immerse both new recruits and hardened soldiers in challenging historical scenarios. With a 25-mission campaign, more than 300 playable units, customizable Commanders, and PvP gameplay, Sudden Strike 5 raises the stakes higher than ever before to create the most epic large-scale tactical warfare experience in the series to date.

*** 

Kalypso Media also publishes critically acclaimed strategy games like the Tropico series, Railway Empire, Commandos, Port Royale, Dungeons, Sudden Strike, and others for PC, PlayStation®, Xbox®, and Nintendo Switch™. Recent releases include Port Royale 4, Tropico 6 - Nintendo Switch™ Edition, Commandos 2 - HD Remaster, Tortuga - A Pirate's Tale, Railway Empire 2, Dungeons 4 and The Inquisitor.
